changes: v2: allows a fourth training round for the schema_augment comparison; the conditions are unchanged.

conditions.then: baseline round: freeze holdouts, evaluate the unchanged base

conditions.when: accepted rows of the counted origins not yet trained on >= min_new_accepted_rows

conditions.then: evaluation round on a fresh holdout
conditions.when: interval_hours since the champion was last evaluated

dimension_basis.determinism: 1.0: static repository JSON; every build yields identical bytes
dimension_basis.evidence_grounding: share of declared references that resolve to records in this pack; a noun without references is self-contained (1.0)
dimension_basis.safety_compliance: share of pack safety checks passed: no secret-like strings, private visibility, no public effect, nothing activated
dimension_basis.token_efficiency: 1 - canonical value bytes / 65536, the per-record budget this pack keeps; floor 0

value.evaluated_by: the tick verb, claimed by an authorized worker

schedule.later: A flag-gated scheduled() handler may enqueue one idempotent tick verb per window. It never trains, evaluates or calls a model, and it grants no authority.
